Tara — thanks for sending these over and for the quick context. A few items before we can fully clear the PO: 

1) W-8BEN-E — please confirm the FATCA chapter 4 classification. If Korro is a Passive NFFE or an Active NFFE, we need the corresponding boxes ticked and the FATCA GIIN (if applicable) provided. At minimum we need: entity type, country of incorporation, and an authorized signatory printed name + capacity on the last page.

2) Bank details — thanks for the redacted copy. Our payments team requires the account holder name to exactly match the legal name on the W-8BEN-E (or evidence of DBA).

3) Provisional PO — we can issue a provisional PO to allow work to start, but finance requires a signed certification from an officer confirming the FATCA classification within 7 business days. If we don’t get that, the provisional PO will be limited to $5k and invoicing will be on hold.

Could you send a short one-paragraph certifying statement (PDF) from your authorized officer and tick the appropriate FATCA box on the W-8BEN-E? If there are any constraints in getting that signed in the next 5 business days, let us know and we’ll route an exception through Legal.

Looping in Dev (Finance ops) and Marissa (Procurement) on next steps.

Best,

Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwoodinference.com
